name: SPIC Industry-Finance Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: SPIC Industry-Finance Holdings Co., Ltd operates primarily in Shijiazhuang, China, where it specializes in the generation and distribution of heat and electricity. The company delivers various heating solutions, including steam and heat, to meet the needs of industrial, commercial, and residential sectors, alongside providing electric power. Founded in 1982, its headquarters are situated in Shijiazhuang. In May 2022, the company adopted its current name, having previously been known as SPIC Dongfang Energy Corporation. It operates as a subsidiary under the State Power Investment Corporation Limited.
